Made by cooking eggs and milk in a special mold, its soft texture melts in your mouth.|Cooking (Interface)|AoC}} ==Location and Uses== ==={{BotW|-}}=== Egg Puddings are made by combining [[Fresh Milk]], a [[Bird Egg]], and [[Cane Sugar]] in a [[Cooking Pot]]. When eaten, they heal six of [[Link]]'s [[Heart]]s. They also sell for 20 [[Rupee]]s. They are made by cooking eggs and milk in a special mold, and they are known to have a soft texture that melts in one's mouth. Link can find a recipe for Egg Pudding written in ''[[Ivee's Diary]]''.{{Cite|Today's Recipe:
{{Color BotW|Blue|Egg Pudding}}|Ivee's Diary|BotW}} In it, [[Ivee]] lists the ingredients as some Bird Eggs, a few bottles of Fresh Milk, and several servings of Cane Sugar.{{Cite|Ingredients:
{{Color BotW|Blue|Bird Eggs}} (a few should do)
{{Color BotW|Blue|Fresh Milk}} (a few bottles)
{{Color BotW|Blue|Cane Sugar}} (let's say...several servings)|Ivee's Diary|BotW}} Though she knows Cane Sugar is difficult to come by, she states that the dish will not work without it.{{Cite|Note: {{Color BotW|Blue|Cane sugar}} can be tough to come by, but the dish will fail without it.|Ivee's Diary|BotW}} By using additional ingredients, different variations of Egg Pudding can be made: * '''Hearty Egg Pudding''':{{Cite|{{Big|Hearty Egg Pudding}}
Restores your health and temporarily increases your maximum hearts.
Made by cooking eggs and milk in a special mold, its soft texture melts in your mouth.|Inventory|BotW}} Eating one will heal all of Link's Hearts and temporarily increase his maximum number of Hearts. Additionally, they sell for 40 Rupees. * '''Energizing Egg Pudding''':{{Cite|{{Big|Energizing Egg Pudding}}
Instantly refills some of your Stamina Wheel.
Made by cooking eggs and milk in a special mold, its soft texture melts in your mouth.|Inventory|BotW}} When eaten, Link's [[Stamina Wheel]] will be refilled. They also heal him for four Hearts and sell for 40 Rupees. * '''Enduring Egg Pudding''':{{Cite|{{Big|Enduring Egg Pudding}}
Restores and overfills your Stamina Wheel.
Made by cooking eggs and milk in a special mold, its soft texture melts in your mouth.|Inventory|BotW}} Not only will these restore Link's Stamina Wheel when eaten, they will also overfill it. They heal Link for five Hearts and sell for 40 Rupees. * '''Hasty Egg Pudding''':{{Cite|{{Big|Hasty Egg Pudding}}
Grants a mid-level movement-speed boost.
Made by cooking eggs and milk in a special mold, its soft texture melts in your mouth.|Inventory|BotW}} If eaten, these will temporarily increase Link's movement speed. They restore three Hearts to Link's Life Gauge, and they'll sell for 50 Rupees. * '''Spicy Egg Pudding''':{{Cite|{{Big|Spicy Egg Pudding}}
Grants low-level cold resistance.
Made by cooking eggs and milk in a special mold, its soft texture melts in your mouth.|Inventory|BotW}} Eating one will temporarily increase Link's [[Cold Resistance]] by one level. They also heal four Hearts in his Life Gauge, and they can be sold for 30 Rupees. * '''Electro Egg Pudding''':{{Cite|{{Big|Electro Egg Pudding}}
Grants low-level electricity resistance.
Made by cooking eggs and milk in a special mold, its soft texture melts in your mouth.|Inventory|BotW}} They grant Link one level of [[Shock Resistance]] when consumed. They also heal him for four Hearts, but they sell for 40 Rupees. * '''Mighty Egg Pudding''':{{Cite|{{Big|Mighty Egg Pudding}}
Grants a low-level attack-power boost.
Made by cooking eggs and milk in a special mold, its soft texture melts in your mouth.|Inventory|BotW}} When eaten, they'll temporarily boost Link's attack power. They also heal for four Hearts, and they can be sold for 40 Rupees. * '''Tough Egg Pudding''':{{Cite|{{Big|Tough Egg Pudding}}
Grants a low-level defense boost.
Made by cooking eggs and milk in a special mold, its soft texture melts in your mouth.|Inventory|BotW}} Eating one will temporarily increase Link's defense. In addition, they'll heal four Hearts in his Life Gauge, and they sell for 40 Rupees. * '''Sneaky Egg Pudding''':{{Cite|{{Big|Sneaky Egg Pudding}}
Grants a low-level stealth boost.
Made by cooking eggs and milk in a special mold, its soft texture melts in your mouth.|Inventory|BotW}} When eaten, they'll grant Link a temporary [[Stealth]] boost. They also restore four Hearts to his Life Gauge, and they're worth 30 Rupees when sold. * '''Chilly Egg Pudding''':{{Cite|{{Big|Chilly Egg Pudding}}
Grants a low-level heat resistance.
Made by cooking eggs and milk in a special mold, its soft texture melts in your mouth.|Inventory|BotW}} Eating one increases Link's [[Heat Resistance]] by one level. They also heal Link for seven Hearts and sell for 40 Rupees. ==={{TotK|-}}=== {{Stub|TotK}} ==Other Appearances== ==={{AoC|-}}=== {{Noncanon|Start}} The [[Recipe]] for Egg Pudding is obtained by completing the [[Scenario]] "[[Each Step Like Thunder]]". It is made using one [[Bird Egg]], one [[Fresh Milk]], and one [[Cane Sugar]]. Preparing Egg Pudding before a [[Challenge]] or [[Scenario]] will increase the drop rate of [[Material]]s by ten percent. {{Noncanon|End}} ==Nomenclature== {{Nomenclature}} ==Gallery== File:AoC Egg Pudding Icon.png|{{Game Label|{{AoC|-}}}}Egg Pudding icon ==See Also== {{See Also| * Egg Tart * Food * Meal }} {{Ref}} {{Categories |Desserts, Food, Health Restoring Items, Meals |items= BotW, TotK, AoC }}
